race.comment: ZOUBABY (11) ran on well to win a similar race here two starts ago then started favourite in open company last start but went under narrowly after giving away a big start. Perfectly placed to return to the winner's circle. LET'SFACETHEMUSIC (6) took the scalp of Braveheart two runs back over this course and distance and that fellow has won twice since. Just as impressive last time out when he thundered home from near last to be beaten just 0.4 lengths here at this trip. Honest sprinter who goes best for Geran who is back aboard. Stakes placegetter FLEETWOOD (1) returns from a 20-week spell. Class runner with four wins and as many placings from nine starts at this distance. Recent trial winner who is in this up to his ears. MOULIN MISS (9) last raced 38 days ago when she scrambled home over 1000m at Eagle Farm. Unbeaten here at this distance so from gate one must be respected. MISTER BIANCO (2) is in the mix at the third run back from a spell.
